svg.title: Brad Hintze | thebradhimself
svg.desc: Terminal-style profile of Brad Hintze, senior software engineer in Mesa, Arizona. Coding since 2010; Rails, Python, JavaScript, Objective-C, Flutter, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Docker, and practical AI. The full information is also available as text in the README.
